newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 12.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- An explosion hits Tokai-mura nuclear fuel reprocessing plant, north of Tokyo. Radiation may have leaked outside.
-- Japan Telecom Co Ltd and International Telecom Japan Inc (ITJ) are to merge as early as autumn 1997.
-- Two Ajinomoto Co Inc executives have been arrested on suspicion of paying several million yen to "sokaiya" racketeers.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto plans to cut spending on long-term public works projects.
-- Watchdog plans to file criminal accusation against Nomura Securities Co Ltd.
-- Defence council for Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect) leader Shoko Asahara to boycott Friday's court session.
